buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 50 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 50% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Past Project Experience The Bidder / OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)}, should have executed project for supply and installation / commissioning of same or similar Category Products during preceding 3 financial years (i.e. current year and three previous financial years) as on opening of bid, as per following criteria: (i) Single order of at least 35% of estimated bid value; or

(ii) Two orders of at least 20% each of estimated bid value; or (iii) Three orders of at least 15% each of estimated bid value. Satisfactory Performance certificate issued by respective Buyer Organization for the above Orders should be uploaded with bid. In case of bunch bids, the Category related to primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion 3. Generic Actual delivery (and Installation & Commissioning (if covered in scope of supply)) is to be done at following address As per Buyer added ATC As per Buyer added ATC As per Buyer added ATC As per Buyer added ATC As per Buyer added ATC . 4. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses ADDITIONAL TERMS AND CONDITIONS FOR PROCUREMENT OF SHELTERS AND MISCELLANEOUS BOQ ITEMS a) Past Experience of Bidders: The bidder should have executed projects for the supply, installation, and commissioning of the same or si milar category of products in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands for any Government Department during the l ast three years, i.e., from 01 Apr 2023 till date. Experience certificates must be attached as per the followi ng criteria:- (i) One single order of at least 35% of the estimated bid value. (ii) Two orders, each of at least 20% of the estimated bid value. (iii) Three orders, each of at least 15% of the estimated bid value. A satisfactory performance certificate issued by the buyer organization must also be uploaded. This is a mandatory requirement. Seller must have minimum 3 Star Rating in GeM Seller Account, Otherwise disqualified in technical bid evaluation stage. b. Delivery Location: (i) Delivery location of all items as per Buyer Added ATC. c. Mandatory Site Inspection: All participating bidders are required to visit the delivery sites in the Andaman & Nicobar Islands a nd submit a site visit certificate.The certificate must be obtained from the authorized BRO represe ntative at the respective supply location and uploaded along with the technical bid documents. d. Partial Modification of GeM Category Specifications – Payment Terms: For Item Serial No. 1 only, the order is for the supply of Completely Built Units (CBUs) at the work site. No separate payment towards supply and installation will be made to the bidder. Payment sha ll be released only after the completely built units are handed over to the user unit at the site. e. Pre-Bid Meeting: A pre-bid meeting for sample approval shall be conducted three days prior to bid closing. Bidders shall submit details of the approved makes proposed to be incorporated. Pre-Bid Meeting Address:

HQ 46 BRTF, Chakragaon, Commander Office, Port Blair, Andaman. Time: 11:00 AM Contact No.: 9487237836 f. Time period Delivery of items shall be completed within 180 days from the date of award of the contract. g. Mandatory OEM Authorization: Bidders must ensure that they are authorized by GeM-registered OEMs, especially for Item No. 1 under the specified bid categories. Uploading a verifiable OEM authorization letter along with the b id is mandatory.Bidders not possessing valid OEM authorization shall be disqualified without furthe r consideration. No additional time shall be granted for arranging such authorization. h. Inclusive Pricing: The quoted rate shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, packaging, loading, unloading, an d door-to-door delivery charges to the final destination. k.Warranty: · The supplied items shall carry a minimum onsite warranty of one (1) years from the date of in stallation. Any defects during this period shall be rectified or replaced by the supplier at no additio nal cost. · If any of the supplied items develop any faults or manufacturing defects with in the stipulated warranty period, the bidder shall repair or replace the defective unit in full and free of co st, failing which the ePGB submitted by the bidder shall be forfeited. j.A notarized affidavit, executed on non-judicial stamp paper of ₹10/-or above, stating that the firm has not been blacklisted, debarred, or barred by any regulatory or statutory authority from undertaking any assign ment. The affidavit shall also state that the owner/proprietor/director(s) of the firm have no criminal record and that no court proceedings involving any Government Department are pending against them. k. Bidders are requested to note that the rates quoted for one shelter shall include the cost of all items as per the specification sheet attached as Appendix ‘A’. l. Bidders are requested to carefully read all terms and conditions and exercise due diligence while submitt ing bids to avoid disqualification or rejection. . 6.
